status_note: Refreshed 2026-08-06 after all open-questions answers landed. Mechanical model confirmed (inflammatory features absent, disc golf gone, groin/back/buttock quiet). goals.primary_intent: Ongoing lower-body strength progression, competitive for CrossFit and Hyrox where legs are the main driver. Not a fixed finish line — the plan continues past every waypoint. Numeric targets are milestones, not endpoints.

waypoints.label: Birthday waypoint
waypoints.note: Hitting either is the birthday PR win. Both is stretch. 180/200 are floor targets given the training history; 190/210+ is realistic on 4x/week with muscle-memory return in cycles 1-2. Plan continues after regardless of outcome.

muscle_memory_expectation.note: User was at 150-153 kg squat last year. Returning trained lifter means TM ramp in cycles 1-3 will be faster than the standard +5 kg/cycle — expect +7.5 to +10 kg/cycle until pre-injury capacity is regained (~cycle 3-4). After that, standard +5 kg/cycle.

2026-12-20_cycle_4_end.note: 1RM test — expect squat 160 kg, pull 190 kg

2027-04-17_pre_birthday.note: TM 165 supports 180 kg squat attempt; TM 188 supports 205+ kg pull

2027-04-24_birthday.note: Attempt window — both PRs plausible if muscle memory returns cleanly

stretch_ambition.note: Where the projected trajectory lands if cycles 1-4 all run green and Hatch/peak execute cleanly. 180/200 was the previous floor target — moved up here based on user's actual training history (150 kg squat last year).

crossfit_hyrox_readiness.note: Strength gains feed CrossFit and Hyrox performance directly. Class squats and heavy conditioning workouts benefit from raw leg strength — not a separate track, but a compound benefit.

progression_targets.note: Trajectory milestones anchored to the April 24 2027 birthday waypoint. TM = training max, ≈ 90% of 5RM. These are what the plan needs to hit to be on-track for AT LEAST ONE of the birthday goals. If both trend on target, the birthday attempt becomes a double-PR opportunity.
progression_targets.auto_adjust_policy: Beating a milestone by ≥1 cycle → offer to accelerate remaining milestones OR bring the birthday attempt forward. Missing a milestone → slip subsequent ones back by one cycle and keep the birthday date fixed. Plan continues past 2027-04-24 regardless of outcome.
progression_targets.trajectory_note: Back squat starts at TM 110, needs ~165 for a 180 kg 1RM. Block pull starts at TM 130, needs ~180 for 200 kg. Deadlift is the more likely birthday PR — trajectory below reflects that.

non_negotiables: Left-right hip strength gap closes as loads increase. Every training week contains meaningful unilateral loading.
No lumbar extension + rotation + axial load stacking. Ever.
Low-bar back squat rack is off the menu — right shoulder posterior instability. High-bar or front rack only.
Conventional deadlift from the floor is phase-gated behind ~4 weeks of symptom-free block pulls.
Volume ramps at ≤10% per week to protect the L5 pseudoarthrosis and right SI subchondral bone.
One full rest day per week. Legs get 4 sessions/week, not 5.

home_garage.notes: Enough for technique work, unilateral, RDLs, front squat up to 55 kg. NOT enough for heavy back squat or heavy deadlift — heavy days are at the box.

crossfit_box.implication: Primary squat is high-bar back squat. Primary pull is block pull mid-shin. Front squat is a working lift alongside back squat (user tolerates front rack with mobility prep and WL shoes). Overhead squats usable with prep. Low-bar back squat stays off due to shoulder posterior instability.

principles.detail: TM-based percentages, submaximal top sets ramping to a week-3 AMRAP. First Set Last 5×5 is the volume work — higher intensity than BBB, faster gains for an experienced lifter.
Provocative positions are deep flexion + adduction + IR, and lumbar extension + rotation. Squat depth is 'no knees caving, no butt wink' — full ROM only when you own the pattern.
3 squat + 1 pull, or 2 squat + 1 pull + 1 mixed. Fractionated volume beats concentrated volume for strength when total weekly load is equated (Norwegian Frequency principle).
Documented left glute-max deficit, left iliopsoas irritability, left rotation weakness. Every session includes a single-leg lift. Left side gets the extra set.

principles.rule: Axial load returns in variants first, straight bar last
principles.detail: High-bar back squat and block pull are the working lifts. Conventional-from-floor unlocks only after block pull is symptom-free at 150 kg for 4 weeks.
Green day: progress. Amber day: hold. Red day: back off two steps and reset TM -10%. Judged by the next morning, not by how it felt during.

training_maxes.note: TM = the number percentages calculate from. 5/3/1 convention: TM ≈ 90% of a solid 5RM. User has not tested — evaluation week sets the real values. Starting estimates below are informed guesses to have numbers before the eval.

evaluation_week.protocol: Ramp in fives to a heavy-but-clean 5RM. Stop when bar speed slows or form breaks. Squat one day (Tue), pull another day (Fri). Spotter for squats.

training_maxes.starting_values_note: Estimates based on 10 years CrossFit training + 100 kg power clean triple 2 days ago. If evaluation-week 5RMs land within ±10 kg of these, use those numbers. Front squat TM ratchets from actual front squat performance in the variant sessions, not tested separately in week 2.
training_maxes.progression_rule: Cycle end all-green: TM +5 kg squat variants, +7.5 kg pull variants. Any amber week: hold TM. Any red week: TM -10%.
training_maxes.reset_rule_5_3_1: If the top set of week 3 fails to hit the required reps (1+ at 95% TM), reduce TM by 10% for the next cycle.

phases.name: Rebuild + evaluate
phases.rationale: User hasn't squatted heavy in 6 months. This is ramp + eval to set real TMs before Phase 2's first real 5/3/1 waves.
phases.goal: Rebuild the pattern under progressive load. Establish real TMs from a 5RM test in the last week of the phase.

week_by_week.week_0_aug_6_9: 2 barbell sessions (Fri + Sat, or as schedule permits): high-bar squat ramping empty bar → 60 kg × 5, block pull ramping empty bar → 80 kg × 5. Home block daily.
week_by_week.week_1_aug_10_16: 4 barbell sessions: Mon high-bar squat 4×5 to 70-80 kg (RPE 6-7); Wed block pull 4×5 to 90-100 kg (RPE 6-7); Thu front squat 3×5 to 60-70 kg + Bulgarian split squat; Sat unilateral + carries + sled.
week_by_week.week_2_aug_17_23: Same as week 1 (repeated). Extra week of moderate load before the eval — protective when there are any hip / groin flags.
week_by_week.week_3_aug_24_29_EVAL: Tue: 5RM high-bar back squat (spotter). Wed: light recovery 3×5 @ 60%. Fri: 5RM block pull. Sat: light recovery 3×5 @ 60%. Mon + Thu = rest. Sun = home block.

weekly_overrides.note: Eval week. Tue + Fri are the 5RM anchor sessions that set real TMs for Phase 2. Wed = light recovery between the two evals. Sat = race day (rest). Mon + Thu = rest before evals.

phases.name: Cycle 1 — first real 5/3/1 FSL (Sept 12 comp mid-cycle)
phases.template_note: Main-lift top sets ramp 65/75/85 → 70/80/90 → 75/85/95% TM. Every top set is an AMRAP. FSL 5×5 = 5 sets of 5 at the first working weight of the day.

cycle_structure.week_2_sep_6_12_COMP_WEEK: 3/3/3 top set. 70/80/90% TM. Schedule heavy squat and pull Mon+Wed. Thu light. Comp Sat 2026-09-12 — expect to feel notably stronger than in years.
cycle_structure.week_3_sep_13_19: 5/3/1 top set. 75/85/95% TM. AMRAP at 95% is the first real strength-jump moment.
cycle_structure.week_4_sep_20_27_DELOAD: 40/50/60% TM 5 reps each. Recovery week. Cycle end review.

phases.name: Cycle 2
phases.goal: TM incremented if cycle 1 was green. Second measurable top-set PR at week 3.

phases.name: Cycles 3 + 4 (with 1RM test)
phases.template: 5/3/1 FSL 5×5; then peaking within cycle 4 for 1RM test

reintroduction_gate.conventional_deadlift: During cycle 3 or 4, if block pull at 150 kg has been symptom-free (green) for 4 consecutive weeks, swap in conventional deadlift for the top set only on Wed. Otherwise stay on block pulls.

phases.test_at_end: Final week of cycle 4 (2026-12-14 to 2026-12-20): 1RM test week. Squat 1RM Tue, DL 1RM (block or conventional) Fri.

phases.name: Hatch Squat Program (12-week specialisation)
phases.template_note: Two dedicated squat days per week for 12 weeks (day A: back squat heavy + front squat lighter; day B: reversed). One pull session per week (block pull with FSL). Fourth session is optional unilateral/accessories.
phases.note_holiday_gap: Dec 21 – Jan 4 is a light/holiday period. Optional 2 sessions/week at 60% TM to keep the groove.

phases.name: Peak — birthday waypoint
phases.test_window: 2027-04-20 to 2027-04-24 — birthday. Attempt 180 kg squat AND/OR 200 kg deadlift (with stretch: 190 / 210+). Hitting one is the win. Plan continues after.

phases.name: Post-birthday — ongoing progression
phases.template: Adaptive — engine generates next cycle structure based on birthday outcome and updated TMs
phases.note: Strength progression does not end at the birthday waypoint. On 2027-04-25 the engine generates the next waypoint (typically +10-15 kg on the achieved lifts, similar duration ahead) and resumes 5/3/1 FSL.

adaptive_engine.note: The plan is designed to self-adjust on cycle boundaries, at symptom-flare events, and on pause/resume. Full engine ships in the Next.js migration. Below is the specification.

on_cycle_end.green_cycle: TM +5 kg (main) or +10 kg if muscle-memory-return AMRAP is strong (top set 8+ reps at 95%). Update milestones forward if beating dated targets by >1 cycle.
on_cycle_end.amber_cycle: Hold TM. Repeat cycle with same numbers.
on_cycle_end.red_cycle: TM -10%. Insert a deload week if not already present. Escalate to clinician if two red cycles consecutive.

on_symptom_flare.trigger: Morning check derived_state = red OR three consecutive amber
on_symptom_flare.action: Cap today's suggestion at 90% of prescription. Banner on Today. Do not increment TM this cycle.

on_pause_resume.action: Automatically insert a calibration mini-cycle on return: week 1 reintro (60-70% previous TM), week 2 eval (5RM test, reset TM = 5RM × 0.90), then resume main progression. Announce clearly: 'You've been away 3 weeks — here's your calibration.'

waypoint_hit.trigger: 1RM attempt on waypoint date meets or exceeds any waypoint condition
waypoint_hit.action: Generate next waypoint 8-12 months out with +10-15 kg targets on lifts hit. Plan continues in phase_7.

waypoint_missed.trigger: 1RM attempt on waypoint date fails all conditions
waypoint_missed.action: Slip waypoint 8 weeks forward, insert one more 5/3/1 cycle + peaking, retry. Adjust downstream milestones. No plateau.

progression_rules.cycle_end_rule: At the end of every 4-week 5/3/1 cycle: if all 4 weeks green → TM +5 kg squat / +7.5 kg pull. Any amber week → hold TM. Any red week → TM -10%.
progression_rules.escalation: Night pain, a clear step-change in symptoms, or three amber weeks in a row means see the orthopaedist. Do not simply keep resetting the TM.

daily_log_schema.derived_state_rule: red if night_pain OR gait_change OR (click_present AND click_painful) OR peak>5; amber if peak>=4 OR morning_stiffness_min>30; else green
